title: ASPA Explorer
description: A web page, a small API and a notification service on top of a Routinator validator: lookups of the validated ASPA objects of the RPKI, AS path and route checks against them, route leaks seen by 30 route collectors, statistics on adoption, feeds, badges and notifications.
